oneLine: Dosti Realty and Moneytree Realty submitted confidential IPO papers to SEBI.

sources.title: Dosti Realty And Moneytree Realty Submit IPO Papers Through Confidential Route, Filings Made With SEBI

synopsis: Dosti Realty Ltd and Moneytree Realty Services Ltd have submitted confidential initial public offering papers to the Securities and Exchange Board of India for main-board listings. Both companies filed pre-filed draft red herring prospectuses in separate public notices dated September 30. Offer structures, valuations, financial performance, and listing timelines remain undisclosed as the confidential pre-filing process keeps draft documents outside the public domain during initial regulatory review. Dosti Realty is a Mumbai-based real estate developer founded in 1979, while Moneytree Realty is a Noida-headquartered real estate consultancy established in 2021. Additionally, Wadhwa Group Holdings Ltd and AssetGro Fintech Ltd have filed IPO draft papers via the confidential route.
